title: Coast Guard hoists mariner after vessel grounded north of Vendovi Island, Wash.
description:
An MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew from Coast Guard Air Station Port Angeles hoists a mariner of the back of a 45-foot Response Boat-Medium from Coast Guard Station Bellingham, after the mariner's 30-foot sailing vessel grounded north of Vendovi Island, Wash., April 11, 2017.

The air crew consisted of Lt. Caled Robards, aircraft commander, Lt. j.g. Kevan Stoeckler, copilot, Avionics Electrical Technician 2nd Class Peter Bradshaw, flight mechanic, and Aviation Survival Technician 3rd Class, Matt Margot, swimmer.

U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Port Angeles.
